about.pitch: Saacadda, taariikhda, maalinta shaqada, cinwaanka iyo koodhka raadraaca ku qor sawiradaada  si aad u diiwaangeliso goobta, baaritaanka goobta iyo caddeynta adeegga.
about.privacyGeocoding: Marka GPS la isticmaalo, nidaamka hawlgalka wuxuu u diraa xuduudka Googles ama adeegga khariidadaha Apples si uu u helo cinwaanka. taasi waa macluumaadka kaliya ee ka haray halkan, waana nidaamka u diraa, ma aha Lymark.
about.privacyLocation: Meesha waxaa loo isticmaalaa hal mar halkii sawir, kaliya si loo buuxiyo goobta cinwaanka, loona keydiyo si gooni ah sawirada.
about.privacyOnDevice: Sawirada, cinwaannada iyo taariikhda ayaa kaliya ku jira qalabkan. Xisaabta ayaa jirta diiwaangelintaada: serverku wuxuu hayaa emaylkaaga iyo qorshahaaga, mana helo sawiradaada ama meesha aad joogtid.
about.title: Ku saabsan Lymark
